contents.text: Compare Microsoft's and Oracle's total revenue.

Microsoft's total revenue for 2026 was $331,839 million, while Oracle's total revenue for 2026 was $67,357 million. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA; ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations)
